query:
Who was it that mentioned sending a prepared note to Tanya so she could relay a specific medical question to the doctor before Loretta's appointment?

Options:
A. Loretta
B. Tanya
C. Diane
D. Kevin
context:
[1] (about=Tanya, episodic, t6 @2026-02-01T17:35:00) Mom sent me the note, I forwarded it to the office Monday. Proactive is always better with cardiology, it lets them prepare rather than react in-room.
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t6 @2026-02-01T17:28:00) That's good news, Mama. Did he address the fluid retention question? And did Tanya's note reach his office in time?
[3] (about=Diane, core, t12 @2026-02-22T14:58:00) Diane calls Loretta every few days; Tanya sends clinical summaries when needed.
[4] (about=Diane, core, t0 @2026-01-11T16:02:00) Emailed Loretta about fluid retention question for Dr. Mensah.
[5] (about=Loretta, said_by=Tanya, profile, t0 @2026-01-11T16:02:00) Tanya says Loretta is ahead of half her actual patients regarding BP log.
[6] (about=Loretta, core, t10 @2026-02-15T16:47:00) Acknowledges Tanya's hard week and tells her to rest.
[7] (about=Marcus, said_by=Loretta, profile, t14 @2026-03-01T16:13:00) Loretta says Marcus asking Tanya is the kind of thing that matters, not the big conversations but the small careful ones.
[8] (about=Marcus, said_by=Tanya, profile, t14 @2026-03-01T16:13:00) Tanya notes Marcus texted her separately this week to ask about Loretta's meds schedule, unprompted, which is new.
[9] (about=Tanya, core, t10 @2026-02-15T16:47:00) Had a hard week with three patients in the unit; is tired but okay.
[10] (about=Tanya, core, t6 @2026-02-01T17:24:00) Forwarded Diane's fluid retention note to Dr. Mensah's office Monday.
agent_answer: A. Loretta — Tanya reports, "Mom sent me the note," so the prepared note sent to Tanya came from Loretta.
